# Bevy bundled font notice

The sandbox uses the Fira Mono subset embedded in `bevy_text` 0.19.1 via Bevy's
`default_font` feature. The font is third-party material under SIL OFL-1.1;
the root MIT license does not apply to it.

- Source: https://github.com/bevyengine/bevy/tree/v0.19.1/crates/bevy_text/src
- Upstream version: Bevy tag `v0.19.1`, crate `bevy_text` 0.19.1.
- Font: `FiraMono-subset.ttf`, subset supplied by upstream; no local changes.
- Copyright: The Mozilla Foundation and Telefonica S.A., 2012–2015.
- License source: https://github.com/bevyengine/bevy/blob/v0.19.1/assets/fonts/FiraMono-LICENSE
- Release notice: include the adjacent `FiraMono-LICENSE` verbatim.

Only the notice is stored here; the font comes from the Cargo dependency.
